skill.summary: Low-level Feishu document block operations via REST API. Use when feishu_doc built-in actions are insufficient: batch update cells, precise position insert,...

latestVersion.changelog:
feishu-block-ops 1.0.0

- Initial release providing direct Feishu document block operations via REST API.
- Supports batch cell updates, precise positioned inserts, block tree traversal, table row/column manipulation, and in-place image replacement.
- Enables advanced use cases not covered by the standard feishu_doc actions.
- Detailed usage instructions, rate limits, API reference, and common patterns included in documentation.
